name: Instable Instable
description: Entropiste accélérant la désintégration des structures ennemies faisant vieillir les constructions et les armures à vitesse exponentielle.

subject.archetype: Instable Instable — Incursion Dissonante Epic furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes instables entre plusieurs réalités. Membres se dupliquant en images fantômes. Couleurs impossibles. Texture glitch comme un fichier corrompu., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's growing ability (adjacent_friendly) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Green light bridging to adjacent allies, strength flowing outward like spreading roots

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Void Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — gaps where reality is missing

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Space where multiple realities overlap, buildings from different dimensions coexisting, sky showing conflicting celestial bodies and impossible colors
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Chromatic aberration splitting colors, spatial tears showing parallel dimensions, partial phasing between states, glitch artifacts and digital corruption, plus empowerment effect — visible strengthening wave reaching friendly targets visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Entropiste accélérant la désintégration des structures ennemies faisant vieillir les constructions et les armures à vitesse exponentielle.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Incursion Dissonante est l'ouverture de fissures entre les réalités, laissant passer des entités impossibles. Leur présence corrompt la structure même du réel.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing with light along the border edges
card_metadata.composition_directive: Wide dramatic shot showing character AND the full environmental scope of their ability's power and reach
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
